test_path: (no dedicated unit test — debug endpoint). isoLocalMidnight / formatLocalIso are duplicates of fetchers/shopify.ts helpers but not covered by shopify.test.ts.

findings.expected: Debug response that does not leak Shopify Admin token characters to the browser network panel.
findings.actual: Response body includes `tokenPrefix: token.slice(0, 10) + '...'` (line 103). A 10-char prefix of a Shopify Admin API token (which is typically `shpat_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx` — 38 chars total) leaks the `shpat_` scheme prefix + first 4 secret chars. Even though the operator is single-user (URL-obscurity), this endpoint has NO operator-only gate, and any logged JSON copy (browser dev-tools / Vercel deploy logs / accidental screenshot) preserves that prefix. For audit-baseline: a debug endpoint should reveal `hasToken: true/false` ONLY, never any token bytes. Phase 9 audit's INFO-3 (cannibalization detection) flagged a similar information-leak pattern.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace `tokenPrefix: token.slice(0, 10) + '...'` with `hasToken: true`. Keep `hasDomain` + `domainVal: domain.slice(0, 15) + '...'` — those are domain identifiers, not secrets.

findings.failing_input: Adversary discovers /api/debug/shopify-fetch URL (URL-obscurity is the only defense).
findings.expected: URL obscurity is the documented single-operator trust model (see operator constraints) — so this is NOT a flag. However, the operator constraints DO mandate token-redaction in any response payload (cross-reference operator/jobs:107 which hard-codes 'הטעינה נכשלה: משתני סביבה חסרים' rather than the env-var values themselves).

findings.failing_input: Hand-crafted dateStr that the regex on line 19 accepts.
findings.expected: Validates with shared isDate from @/lib/dateValidation (rejects 2026-99-99 / 2026-02-30 — Codex-NEW-5 / HIGH-14 fix).
findings.actual: Uses regex-only check on line 19 + line 66 — the SAME pre-fix pattern that HIGH-14 + Codex-NEW-5 corrected for operator/backfill + operator/manual-overrides. 2026-13-01 would propagate to Date.UTC and silently normalize. Lower severity here because endpoint is debug-only.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace the inline regex with `import { isDate } from '@/lib/dateValidation'; if (!isDate(date)) return 400`.

findings.failing_input: Same TZ edge cases that fetchers/shopify.ts hits.
findings.expected: Helper imported from a shared TZ module so debug + production stay in sync.
findings.actual: Duplicated copy of fetchers/shopify.ts helpers (Asia/Jerusalem TZ math). If shopify.ts ever fixes a TZ edge (DST near 02:00), the debug endpoint reports the OLD behavior and the operator's debugging signal becomes misleading.
findings.fix_sketch: Export isoLocalMidnight + formatLocalIso from fetchers/shopify.ts and import here.
findings.regression_test_idea: Compare debug endpoint's dayStartA against the production fetcher's dayStartA for a DST-edge date (e.g. 2026-03-27 Israel spring-forward).
